topic_thesis: Raising a child in India is no longer an emotional milestone; it is a high-stakes financial liability that the middle class is failing to hedge against.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Parental Retirement Suicide' trap, where parents sacrifice their own retirement corpus and emergency funds to fuel the rising cost of private education and lifestyle inflation, effectively turning children into an unhedged debt instrument.
key_statistic: ₹1.5 crore estimated cost to raise a child in a Tier-1 city, including inflation-adjusted education costs, while fertility rates drop below 2.0.
target_emotion: Anxiety-driven realization of personal financial insolvency.
